lines.text: Isaiah calls the nations to listen, because the LORD is angry with all of them and will give them over to slaughter.
The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and then the LORD's sword will come down upon Moab.
The LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and He has a day of vengeance for the cause of Zion.
Edom's streams will turn to tar, and the desert owl and raven will possess the land.
Her towers will be overgrown with olives and grapevines, and the owl will make her nest and hatch her eggs there.
